question: Why should one remember the sixfold path established by this as foundation of manifestation?
premises: One should remember the sixfold path.
It is foundation of manifestation by god.
inference: The verse enjoins remembrance of the sixfold path as divine foundation of manifestation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of anena is uncertain.
plain_english: Thus one should remember the sixfold path established by this; indeed the foundation by god is manifestation of which universe.
